Implemented Phase 51 on phase-51-role-neutrality, commit e34b298. Review docs/phases/role-neutrality.md implementation notes and docs/releases/3.12.0.md. Version metadata synchronized with scripts/release.py; nothing published or installed downstream.

Concrete provider-to-role assumptions fixed:
- Watcher completion notices sent Claude-only /tagteam:handoff to Codex and were rejected before model delivery (reproduced by user in this cycle). Terminal slash start/turn requests now translate to plain text while structured state commands stay intact for headless validation; plan completion explicitly requests implementation.
- Tmux titles hardcoded CLAUDE (Lead)/CODEX (Reviewer); now use configured names. Missing-role launch defaults no longer silently pick providers.
- Setup readiness required Claude skill/plugin; now checks canonical packaged contract plus framework markers. Optional plugin/vendored paths retained. Absent-only AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md pointers use docs/workflows.md; existing instructions preserved. Reusable templates consult current configuration. Status/priming reports roles, commands, root and entry point.
- Cycle init/add/AMEND and watcher dispatch validate active participants against freshly read configuration; checks repeat inside writer lock. Human rulings remain available. Independent automated entry points HeadlessEngine.run_owed_turn and lead_chat.start_turn needed the same guard; stale cached headless agent config requires watcher restart.

Focused verification passed: watcher/session 46; setup/templates 44; participants/cycle/watcher 108 + 1 skipped; config/headless/lead-chat 204; recovery/onboarding/read-only 219; final participant/setup/onboarding 38. Broader plugin/roadmap/panel/briefer/gate checks had 400 pass and two pre-existing vendored-copy assumptions; both tests updated to assert plugin/packaged parity and then passed. Scope/plan-doc preflight passed with --skip-tests. Full suite: gate, see entry at e34b298 (on_submit is the recorded run).

Limits called out in plan/release notes: no pane identity tracking; recreate sessions after switching. Guards protect workflow submissions, not arbitrary writes. Direct Python callers with no config retain explicit-name API. Read-only DB access may refresh pre-existing WAL index per Phase 50; refusal does not write workflow history. Phase 52 still required before downstream migration.

Pre-existing docs/workflows.md edits, deleted local vendored skill, and iTerm issue note preserved outside commit; no blanket setup/upgrade. Gate scope may show the pre-existing deletion; it was present before this implementation.

Addressed round-1 gate bounce in commit 06a9eda (implementation remains e34b298).

All 27 full-suite failures were legacy test expectations affected by the approved changes: AMEND/baseline/project-root cycle fixtures now provide matching L/R participants instead of invalid agents: {}; quickstart readiness assertions no longer require Claude skill/plugin; terminal dispatch expects a portable plain-text contract request. Preserved the original behavioral assertions. Also fixed an import-order mock leak exposed by running these files together: import the iTerm re-export module before tabs helpers are patched, so it cannot retain a MagicMock after teardown.

Focused verification: all 128 tests in test_cycle_amend.py, test_cycle_baseline.py, test_project_root.py, test_quickstart.py and test_terminal_backend.py pass. git diff --check and gate scope/plan-doc preflight with --skip-tests pass. Scope, implementation notes, release candidate 3.12.0 and preservation of pre-existing local changes remain as in round 1. No publication or downstream migration.

Gate: PASS at HEAD 06a9eda — 1785 passed, 5 skipped, 6m16s; scope 41 paths; plan-doc ok. Reconciles with round 1 (27 failed + 1758 passed = 1785). Taken as the recorded run; no separate suite run by the reviewer.

Reviewed the full diff of e34b298 (implementation) and 06a9eda (test alignment). Every approved plan item is present with tests: contract-based readiness (setup.needs_setup no longer consults the plugin), neutral shipped templates and data/workflows.md, absent-only AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md pointers, role onboarding via describe_roles in state/quickstart/priming, configured tmux titles, get_launch_commands refusing missing roles, and the participant guard at cycle init/add/AMEND (pre-mutation and inside the writer lock), watcher._dispatch, HeadlessEngine.run_owed_turn and lead_chat.start_turn, with add_ruling bypassing it. Confirmed the headless engine receives the same parsed config the guard re-reads, so the config-changed comparison holds in normal operation. Terminal turn/completion messages are plain text via terminal_turn_message; state commands keep their structured form. Round-2 test changes preserve the behavioral assertions and only encode the approved semantics.

Non-blocking, tidy before or after merge (arbiter's call):
1. Shipped handoff templates render "From: Lead (read current tagteam.yaml) (Lead)" — the role word is doubled. Drop the trailing "(Lead)"/"(Reviewer)" in handoff_plan.md/handoff_impl.md.
2. gatekeeper.py:928/1034 and panel.py:974 print "tell the reviewer to run /tagteam:handoff" to the console regardless of the reviewer's provider. Human-facing only; CONTRACT_HOWTO would make it neutral.
3. tests/test_participants.py::test_direct_headless_entry_refuses_before_process constructs the engine with config={} and so passes through the "configuration changed" branch, not the participant-mismatch branch. Build it with the original parsed config to exercise the guard it names.
4. templates.py still computes lead/reviewer variables that no shipped template consumes — dead but harmless.

Arbiter notes: the branch commits tagteam.yaml with codex lead / claude reviewer and the version bump to 3.12.0, so merge puts both on main. Phase 52 (safe migration) is still required before downstream projects upgrade, as the release notes state.
